feature: B2B SaaS Pricing Page — 3 plans (Starter, Team, Enterprise) with monthly/yearly toggle and highlighted recommended plan
screens: Pricing grid — desktop (3-column plan cards with feature comparison)
Pricing stack — mobile (vertical cards + accordion feature lists)
Enterprise modal/contact form (for Contact Sales CTA)
Toggle error/toast states and CTA disabled state overlay
components: Top bar: small headline (H6) + month/year toggle (segmented control)
Pricing Card (reusable) — header (plan name + recommended badge) + price area + billing note + feature list (check/limited/disabled rows) + primary CTA + secondary link (view details)
Recommended Badge — prominent ribbon or chip
Feature comparison matrix (desktop) — table with row labels left, plan columns right
Monthly/Yearly Toggle — segmented control with animated price swap and discount hint (e.g., “Save 20%/yr”)
Enterprise Modal — contact form (name, company, email, team size, message), success & error states
Toast / Inline Error — toggle load failure message with Retry action
Disabled CTA overlay — tooltip explaining restriction (e.g., trial limit)
interactions: Toggle switch: tap changes pricing view with 200ms crossfade + numeric count animation for price (prefers-reduced-motion = reduce animations)
Toggle loading: show skeletons in price area; disable CTAs while loading
Toggle failure: show inline toast with error message + Retry (re-fetch prices)
Price change animation: fade + slide up for new price; discount badge animates in from top
Recommended plan emphasis: elevated card (scale 1.03), 2px shadow increase, 8px outline accent; keyboard-focusable
CTA actions: Starter/Team primary = Start free (opens signup flow), Enterprise primary = Contact sales (opens modal)
Feature rows: hover/focus highlight row; on mobile features collapse into accordion per card
Accessibility: all interactive components keyboard operable, aria-live region for price updates, aria-pressed for toggle, descriptive aria-labels
Disabled CTA: shows 12px helper text and tooltip on hover/focus explaining reason
states: Default: prices show monthly by default (or last saved preference)
Yearly: prices show discounted annual price and “You save X%” subtext
Loading toggle: skeleton blocks for price & features; CTAs disabled
Toggle failure: toast with message “Unable to fetch prices” + Retry button; CTAs re-enabled using last-known prices if available
CTA disabled: state for when signup not available — button greyed, aria-disabled true, tooltip on hover/focus
Form states (Enterprise modal): idle, validating, success (thank-you message), server error (inline field or top error summary)
Empty/Edge: feature list overflow uses vertical scroll inside card at fixed height (max 420px)
responsive: Desktop: 3-column equal-width grid, comparison matrix visible. Tablet (≥768px & <1024px): 2-column grid with Enterprise stacked below; comparison uses condensed table or grouped accordion. Mobile (<768px): vertical card stack; each card contains a collapsible feature accordion and primary CTA pinned to card bottom. Touch targets ≥44×44px, 16px outer padding, 16–20px card gap. Breakpoint specs: mobile 0–767px, tablet 768–1023px, desktop ≥1024px.
design_system: Tokens: color-primary (#0A66FF), color-accent (#0B7AFF), neutral-900, neutral-700, neutral-300, success, error; spacing scale (space-4=8px,8=16px,16=32px, etc.); typography: Inter (H1 28/36, H2 20/28, body 16/24); radius-2 (6px) for cards; elevation tokens (e1,e2). Components to deliver in Figma: PricingCard (variants: default/recommended/disabled), Toggle (states: idle/active/loading/error), FeatureRow (included/limited/not included), Enterprise Modal, Toast. Export assets: badge SVG, check/close icons (24px, SVG), ribbon. Provide layout specs: 12-column grid (desktop), gutters 24px; spacing token mapping, pixel-perfect distances, and component measurements. Accessibility tokens: focus-outline 3px color-accent, contrast ratios >=4.5:1 for body text.
api_needs: GET /pricing?billing=monthly|yearly — returns plans, prices, discounts, feature matrix
GET /pricing/last-known — fallback cached prices for toggle failure
POST /leads/contact-sales — enterprise contact form submission (name, company, email, team_size, message)
acceptance_criteria: Monthly/Yearly toggle updates all displayed prices and shows discount badge for yearly
Recommended plan visually distinct (ribbon + scale + outline) and marked in DOM for screen readers
Toggle loading shows skeleton and disables CTAs; toggle failure shows retryable toast and falls back to cached prices
Desktop shows 3-column grid and comparison matrix; tablet and mobile follow responsive rules with no horizontal scroll
CTAs have correct actions: Start free opens signup flow; Contact sales opens modal and submits to API with validation
Figma handoff includes components with variants, tokens, spacing specs, exportable SVGs, and notes for dev (ARIA labels, reduced-motion)
